references.claim: Model-driven simple agent loop, broad provider support including Ollama, custom providers; repository and docs agree.
Session persistence exists; persistence occurs on lifecycle events and session manager is not thread-safe. Security warning around symlink-following in trusted storage.
Official evaluation SDK supports output, trajectory, tool-use, interaction, deterministic and LLM-judge evaluation, trace-based evaluation and experiment serialization.
Ollama provider supports local invocation, streaming and tool/function calling.
Repo documents mirrored unit/integration tests and explicit testing patterns.

context: context token telemetry surfaced in releases
tool catalog injected through model interaction
memory: persistence store; not equivalent to long-term memory
security: symlink behavior in trusted session directory is a documented risk
portability: Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, LiteLLM, Llama, Writer and custom providers
efficiency: context-token telemetry and tool-result truncation improvements surfaced in releases
contradictions: model intelligence vs explicit workflow durability
unknowns: full exact state schema across all session managers
